# Return <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Return
Return value
```

## Description

Leaves the current [Function](Function), giving back `value` when the function has a return type. In a function declared `Void`, `Return` can not give a value. In code that was entered with [Gosub](Gosub), `Return` goes back to the line after the `Gosub`.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Function Sign$(n)
	If n < 0 Then Return "negative"
	If n > 0 Then Return "positive"
	Return "zero"
End Function

Print Sign$(-4)
Print Sign$(0)
```

```text
negative
zero
```
